title: IRC localization catalog
description: Defines the structure and text values for this localization catalog.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema for this catalog.

Welcome.description: Welcome numeric text. {0} is the server name and {1} is the nickname.

YourHost.description: Your-host numeric text. {0} is the server host and {1} is its version.

ServerCreated.description: Server-created numeric text. {0} is the server creation time.

AreSupportedByThisServer.description: Phrase introducing the server's supported IRC features.

Registration.description: Messages sent while an IRC connection registers.

EndOfNames.description: End marker for a NAMES response.

EndOfWho.description: End marker for a WHO response.

EndOfWhoIs.description: End marker for a WHOIS response.

EndOfList.description: End marker for a LIST response.

NoTopicIsSet.description: Reply when a channel has no topic.

NoSuchChannel.description: Reply when the requested channel does not exist.

NoSuchNickChannel.description: Reply when a nickname or channel cannot be found.

IrcGateway.description: Server description shown in IRC information replies.

SecondsIdleSignonTime.description: Labels for the idle duration and sign-on time in a WHOIS response.

TopicManagedByServer.description: Topic notice explaining that the server controls channel topics.

ModesManagedByServer.description: Mode notice explaining that the server controls channel modes.

Query.description: Text used by IRC queries and their result headers.

NoMotd.description: Reply when the server has no message of the day.

MotdStart.description: Opening line for the message of the day. {0} is the server name.

EndOfMotd.description: Closing line for the message of the day.

Motd.description: Messages used to report and delimit the message of the day.

LusersClients.description: Network client-count line. {0} is the connected user count.

ChannelsFormed.description: Label following the count of channels formed.

LusersMe.description: Local server client-count line. {0} is the client count.

Lusers.description: Text used by the LUSERS command to report connection counts.

ListUsers.description: Heading for the user-count and channel-name columns.

List.description: Column headings in a LIST response.

PasswordIncorrect.description: Reply when the supplied password is incorrect.

NicknameInUse.description: Reply when the requested nickname is already in use.

ErroneousNickname.description: Reply when the requested nickname is invalid.

YouHaveNotRegistered.description: Reply when a command requires registration.

NotEnoughParameters.description: Reply when a command is missing required parameters.

CannotJoinChannel.description: Reply when the user is not allowed to join a channel.

NicknameChangeNotSupported.description: Reply when a nickname change is requested.

UnknownCommand.description: Reply when the server does not recognize a command.

CannotSendToChannel.description: Reply when the user cannot send to a channel.

Errors.description: Text explaining IRC command and registration errors.

Irc.description: Text used in IRC registration, query, MOTD, and error replies.
